# proxmox_cluster_log (Data Source)

Reads recent cluster log entries from `/cluster/log`, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cluster_log" "l" { max = 20 }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max` (Number) Maximum entries, default 100.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `message` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `pri` (Number)
- `tag` (String)
- `time` (Number)
- `user` (String)
